title: Impostor Run: Swarm

selected_categories.reasoning: The central loop is surviving as long as possible in an open arena while hazards steadily increase and a collision ends the run.
The game continually intensifies by adding more enemies over time, creating wave-like pressure even though formal wave phases are not explicitly separated.
It uses a single-screen arena with character movement and hostile entities, but there is no combat, so the match is mainly spatial rather than literal fighting.
The game has continuous dodge-and-collect flow and forward tension similar to runner pacing, but movement is fully freeform rather than lane-based.
The run is endless and score-driven with escalating difficulty, but it lacks auto-forward movement and runner track structure.

uncertainty_notes: The category universe does not contain a precise 'arcade dodger' or 'collect-and-avoid arena survival' label, so the best fit is approximate.
The impostor theme could suggest stealth, but the implemented mechanics are not stealth-driven.
Wave defense and runner-style categories are partial analogies rather than exact matches.
